# AC lines, floors 1-3: routed below the bathroom windows (generated by tools/build_mep.py)

Family instruction: route every AC line on floors 1-3 below the bathroom window; report clashes instead of moving the line.

Route used for each room (same on F1, F2 and F3): from the indoor unit straight through its external wall at the unit's height, along the outside of the wall above the window heads, down beside the bathroom window (on the indoor-unit side), then under the bathroom window sill to an outdoor unit on a bracket centred below that window.

| Room | Bathroom window | Facade | Line length (F1) | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ROOM-1 | F-W7 (1'-11 5/8" wide) | front | 12'-2 5/8" | **CLASH:** outdoor unit only 0'-1 1/2" from waste stack W2 |
| ROOM-2 | F-W6 (1'-11 5/8" wide) | front | 12'-2 5/8" | **CLASH:** line crosses RWP-3 (x 2.40); outdoor unit only 0'-1 1/2" from down-take DT-F |
| ROOM-3 | F-W2 (1'-11 5/8" wide) | rear | 10'-10 7/8" | **CLASH:** outdoor unit only 0'-1 1/2" from down-take DT-R |
| ROOM-4 | F-W3 (1'-11 5/8" wide) | rear | 17'-7 5/8" | **CLASH:** outdoor unit only 0'-1 1/2" from waste stack W1 |

## Cannot be checked
- **Beams and columns:** none are drawn on the AFTER O.C. sheet, so beam and column clashes cannot be checked. Each line passes through its external wall about 7'-10 1/2" above floor, close to where a perimeter beam would sit. The structural engineer must confirm the sleeve level clears the beam.
- **Outdoor units below a ventilator** blow warm air up past the bathroom window; screen or louvre if needed.

Nothing has been moved to avoid the clashes above, as instructed.
